scope: Reviewed notification claims only; not full six-source reconciliation.

rows.conflict: Personal notification selection is not scanner enablement or workflow enforcement.
rows.requirement: Assess subscription, delivery preference, scanner capability and effective enforcement separately with exact recipient/repository scope.
rows.negative_test: Failed-only preference cannot satisfy required-check enforcement; enabled scanner cannot imply recipient subscription.

rows.conflict: Security-alert access, owner administration and commit-author overrides differ.
rows.requirement: Parameterize role, repository administration, alert access and event identity; preserve author preference override narrowly.
rows.negative_test: Organization owner without repository administration cannot inherit listed admin notification guarantee; author override cannot apply to all watchers.

rows.conflict: Routing alone does not enable delivery; GHES address prose conflicts with verified-address steps.
rows.requirement: Keep address verification, approved-domain restriction, delivery opt-in and product interface separate; disputed GHES behavior remains unknown pending independent observation.
rows.negative_test: Configured route cannot pass if delivery disabled or approved-domain verification missing; conflict cannot become assumed supported behavior.

rows.conflict: Trigger severity, event granularity and digest capacity differ complete alert inventory.
rows.requirement: Track all known target alerts separately from delivered notifications, retaining new-versus-updated event distinction and digest limits.
rows.negative_test: Ten-repository digest cannot certify all estate alerts; missing notification on vulnerability update cannot prove absence of vulnerability.

rows.conflict: Marketing opt-out and explicit secret-author override are category-specific.
rows.requirement: Treat optional marketing subscription as personal preference, separate account/security delivery; do not invent general mandatory-security overrides.
rows.negative_test: Marketing unsubscribe cannot prove security disabled; unspecified delivery rule cannot inherit secret-author exception.

rows.conflict: Procedure and preferences do not demonstrate actual delivery or recovery.
rows.requirement: Require authorized event/recipient/time/target and observed delivery evidence, freshness, negative case and recovery test; no automatic settings mutation.
rows.negative_test: Saved preference or documented assignment trigger without observed recipient delivery remains not verified.

limitations: Negative tests specify future bindings; they were not implemented or executed in this tranche.
Identity validation is not semantic equivalence or completeness assurance.
Native delivery tests and settings changes remain approval-gated; no rights clearance.
